title: Aurora CFO says 30,000 driverless trucks by 2030 isn’t as far-fetched as it sounds
summary: Aurora's CFO asserts the company's plan to deploy 30,000 autonomous trucks by 2030 is achievable, not merely aspirational. The self-driving company argues its aggressive targets are realistic given current progress in the technology.
content: Self-driving truck company Aurora laid out an audacious plan for 2030. Its CFO says its targets aren't aspirational.

zh.title: Aurora首席财务官称到2030年部署3万辆无人驾驶卡车并非遥不可及
zh.summary: Aurora首席财务官声称该公司到2030年部署3万辆自动驾驶卡车的计划是可实现的，而不仅仅是雄心勃勃。这家自动驾驶公司辩称其激进的目标在考虑到当前技术进展的情况下是现实的。

title: Experts worry about Nvidia's AI chip sales in China and influence over Trump
summary: China may allow domestic companies like ByteDance and Alibaba to purchase Nvidia chips currently banned under U.S. export restrictions. The potential workaround raises concerns among experts about preserving Nvidia's market dominance despite trade policies.
content: China is reportedly mulling letting ByteDance, Alibaba buy banned Nvidia chips.

zh.title: 专家担忧英伟达在中国的AI芯片销售和对特朗普的影响力
zh.summary: 中国可能允许字节跳动和阿里巴巴等国内公司购买目前根据美国出口限制而被禁止的英伟达芯片。这种潜在的变通方案引起了专家的担忧，在贸易政策限制下英伟达仍能保持其市场主导地位。

title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
summary: AMD is acquiring World Labs, an AI research company founded by renowned researcher Fei-Fei Li, for $8.2 billion in an all-stock deal. The acquisition brings Li on as executive vice president and chief scientist while adding World Labs' world-generation model Marble to AMD's portfolio.
content:
World Labs co-founder and CEO Fei-Fei Li. | Bloomberg via Getty Images	

AMD announced today that it's acquiring World Labs, an AI research lab co-founded by the prominent researcher Dr. Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock deal worth approximately $8.2 billion. World Labs launched in 2024 and was valued at $1 billion in a matter of months. The startup launched its first commercial product, a world generation model called Marble that lets users make interactive 3D worlds from a prompt, in 2025.
The deal is expected to close by the end of the year. Li will become EVP and chief scientist at AMD, reporting to AMD CEO Lisa Su, while the World Labs team will "continue to focus on advancing AI model research." AMD also notes t …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: AMD以超过80亿美元的价格收购AI公司World Labs
zh.summary: AMD以82亿美元的全股票交易方式收购了由著名研究员李飞飞创建的AI研究公司World Labs。此次收购将李飞飞聘为执行副总裁兼首席科学家，同时将World Labs的世界生成模型Marble加入AMD的产品组合。

title: Source: Inference provider Modal Labs closing in on $750M round at $15.75B valuation
summary: Modal Labs is raising approximately $750 million at a $15.75 billion valuation, more than tripling its value in just four months. The funding surge reflects strong investor confidence in AI infrastructure for model inference and deployment.
content: The new financing is expected to more than triples the AI infrastructure startup's valuation from just four months ago.

zh.title: 消息人士：推理提供商 Modal Labs 即将完成 7.5 亿美元融资，估值 157.5 亿美元
zh.summary: Modal Labs 正在以 157.5 亿美元估值融资约 7.5 亿美元，仅在四个月内估值增长超过两倍。融资热潮反映了投资者对人工智能推理和部署基础设施的强烈信心。

title: SpaceX's Starship goes orbital, deploying first next-gen Starlinks
summary: SpaceX's Starship rocket achieved orbital flight and successfully deployed next-generation Starlink satellites on its latest mission. The milestone completes Starship's transition from suborbital test flights to operational space delivery.
content: Starship had already flown 99 percent of the way to low-Earth orbit. Monday's flight added the last bit.

zh.title: SpaceX 星舰进入轨道，部署首批下一代星链卫星
zh.summary: SpaceX 星舰火箭在最新任务中成功进入轨道并部署了下一代星链卫星。这一里程碑标志着星舰从亚轨道测试飞行向运营性太空运输的完全转变。

title: Florida invokes extinction fears in legal bid to halt OpenAI development
summary: Florida filed a legal challenge against OpenAI, claiming large language models pose an existential threat and constitute the "greatest public nuisance ever created." The state's unusual legal strategy seeks to halt AI development by invoking extinction risk arguments.
content: State says LLMs threaten civilization as "the greatest public nuisance ever created."

zh.title: 佛罗里达州以灭绝威胁为由发起法律诉讼欲阻止 OpenAI 开发
zh.summary: 佛罗里达州对 OpenAI 提起法律诉讼，声称大型语言模型构成存在威胁，是"有史以来最大的公共危害"。该州采用不寻常的法律策略，试图通过援引灭绝风险论据来阻止人工智能开发。

title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 billion
summary: AMD is acquiring World Labs, co-founded by prominent AI researcher Fei-Fei Li, for $8.2 billion. Li will join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist, bringing significant AI research expertise to the company.
content: The acquisition will see World Labs founder Fei-Fei Li join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.

zh.title: AMD将以82亿美元收购李飞飞的World Labs公司
zh.summary: AMD正在收购由著名AI研究员李飞飞共同创立的World Labs公司，收购价格为82亿美元。李飞飞将加入AMD担任执行副总裁兼首席科学家，为公司带来重要的AI研究专业知识。

title: New device captures carbon dioxide by pumping it across a battery
summary: A new carbon capture device uses a battery-based system to extract CO2 while consuming significantly less energy than current industrial methods. The technology could improve the economics and scalability of direct air capture solutions.
content: The design requires less energy to capture CO2 than current systems.

zh.title: 新装置通过在电池中泵送来捕获二氧化碳
zh.summary: 一种新的碳捕获装置使用基于电池的系统来提取二氧化碳，同时消耗的能量比目前的工业方法少得多。该技术可以改善直接空气捕获解决方案的经济性和可扩展性。

title: To keep drug prices high, pharma has been piling up the patents
summary: Pharmaceutical companies have extended drug patent periods from two to over six years through strategic patenting of minor modifications and add-ons. The practice allows companies to maintain high prices and delay generic drug competition beyond original patent protection timelines.
content: Add-on patents have increased drug patent periods from two years to over six.

zh.title: 为了保持药物价格高位，制药公司一直在堆积专利
zh.summary: 制药公司通过对微小修改和附加功能进行战略性专利申请，将药物专利期限从两年延长到六年以上。这种做法使公司能够维持高价格并将仿制药竞争延迟到原始专利保护时间表之外。

title: Trump cuts fuel economy standards back to 2014 levels
summary: The Trump administration has reduced fuel economy standards (CAFE) from 40 mpg to 35 mpg, reverting to 2014-era regulations. This marks the second rollback of fuel efficiency requirements during Trump's current tenure.
content: In 2020, Trump cut CAFE to 40 mpg. Now he’s cut it again to just 35 mpg.

zh.title: 特朗普将燃料经济性标准降至2014年水平
zh.summary: 特朗普政府已将燃料经济性标准(CAFE)从40 mpg降低至35 mpg，恢复至2014年的规定。这是特朗普现任期间对燃料效率要求的第二次削减。

title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
summary: Shopify has expanded WebMCP support to its checkout process, enabling AI agents to complete purchases and modify order details with customer authorization. The integration allows browser-based AI to directly interact with e-commerce transactions.
content: Shopify is expanding WebMCP support to checkout, allowing browser-based AI agents to update order details and complete purchases with a buyer’s authorization.

zh.title: Shopify向基于浏览器的AI代理开放结账功能
zh.summary: Shopify已将WebMCP支持扩展到其结账流程，使AI代理能够在获得客户授权的情况下完成购买和修改订单详情。该集成允许基于浏览器的AI直接与电子商务交易互动。

title: Bose starts adding Auracast to its headphones
summary: Bose is adding Auracast support to its QuietComfort Ultra Headphones Gen 2 via firmware update, enabling Bluetooth LE Audio-based audio sharing. The addition positions Bose among major manufacturers supporting the accessibility-focused audio standard.
content:
The flagship Bose headphones will now be able to connect to Auracast broadcasts for better accessibility. | Image: The Verge	

A new firmware update for the $449 Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones Gen 2 adds support for Bluetooth LE Audio and Auracast as beta features. The flagship Ultra headphones are the first from Bose to support the audio sharing technology, which the company plans to bring to more devices soon.
Only a few major manufacturers include Auracast, and only on select headphones or earbuds - including Sony, JBL headphones, Samsung Galaxy Buds, and Sennheiser, which also released an Auracast transmitter this year. Some smaller companies, like EarFun, have added support. But Bose is one of the most recognizable names in headphones, so the fact that it' …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Bose开始在其耳机中添加Auracast功能
zh.summary: Bose通过固件更新为其QuietComfort Ultra Headphones Gen 2添加Auracast支持，实现基于蓝牙LE音频的音频共享。这一补充使Bose成为支持这一无障碍音频标准的主要制造商之一。

title: Tesla delays Roadster 2 event again due to bad weather
summary: Tesla has delayed the Roadster 2 unveiling event again due to weather concerns, as the demonstration requires outdoor conditions to showcase the car's SpaceX thruster-powered flying capability. The repeated postponements suggest logistical challenges with the planned spectacle.
content: Tesla says the event "can only be held outdoors," as it's expected to show the car flying in some form using SpaceX thrusters.

zh.title: 特斯拉因天气恶劣再次延迟Roadster 2活动
zh.summary: 特斯拉因天气问题再次延迟Roadster 2的发布活动,因为演示需要户外条件来展示该车的SpaceX推进器驱动的飞行能力。反复延期暗示计划中的盛况存在后勤挑战。

title: The AI boom took over Climate Week and not everyone is happy about it
summary: AI and data center discussions have dominated Climate Week, creating divisions among climate tech founders and investors about priorities and resource allocation. The surge in AI focus reflects broader industry tensions between climate and artificial intelligence concerns.
content: Just like the rest of the U.S, data centers and AI are dividing climate tech founders and investors.

zh.title: 人工智能热潮接管了气候周,并非所有人都对此满意
zh.summary: 人工智能和数据中心讨论主导了气候周,在气候科技创始人和投资者之间关于优先事项和资源分配产生了分歧。AI关注度的激增反映了气候和人工智能关注之间更广泛的行业紧张关系。

title: Kalshi loses again as judges rule prediction markets must obey gambling laws
summary: Kalshi, a prediction market platform, has lost another court ruling requiring prediction markets to comply with state gambling laws. The legal defeat suggests the company's broader challenge to gambling regulations may escalate to the Supreme Court.
content: Kalshi's defiance of state gambling laws may be headed to Supreme Court.

zh.title: Kalshi再次败诉,法官裁定预测市场必须遵守赌博法律
zh.summary: 预测市场平台Kalshi在另一项法庭判决中败诉,要求预测市场遵守州赌博法律。这次法律败诉暗示该公司对赌博法规的更广泛挑战可能升级到最高法院。

title: Ocean surveillance startup Quartermaster raises another $140M
summary: Quartermaster, an ocean surveillance startup, has raised an additional $140M to expand its real-time maritime monitoring technology, which addresses what the company describes as the largest surveillance gap on Earth.
content: The tech enables real-time awareness for what Quartermaster calls the “largest blind spot on Earth.”

zh.title: 海洋监视初创公司Quartermaster再融资1.4亿美元
zh.summary: 海洋监视初创公司Quartermaster再融资1.4亿美元，用于扩展其实时海事监测技术，该公司声称该技术解决了地球上最大的监测空白。

title: Philips’ motion-tracking smart toothbrush uses AI to make you a better brusher
summary: Philips has launched its AI-powered DiamondClean 9900 Prestige smart toothbrush with motion-tracking capabilities in Europe and the US at $379.99, undercutting competitors like Dyson while offering advanced dental monitoring features.
content:
First announced in July with an expected limited launch later this year, the Philips Sonicare Next-Generation DiamondClean 9900 Prestige smart toothbrush is now available in Europe and the US, with a broader global rollout expected in 2027. While the previous iteration is still available and discounted from $429.99, the new "Next-Gen DiamondClean" version is debuting for $379.99 even with its added capabilities. It doesn't floss for you, but it's cheaper than Dyson's $499 CameraJet smart toothbrush that some early adopters are having issues with.

Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 飞利浦运动追踪智能牙刷使用AI助你成为更好的刷牙者
zh.summary: 飞利浦在欧美推出其AI驱动的DiamondClean 9900 Prestige智能牙刷，具有动作追踪功能，售价379.99美元，与Dyson等竞争对手相比价格更低，同时提供先进的牙齿监测功能。

title: SpaceX preps next-gen Starlink as Amazon’s competitor stalls
summary: SpaceX is preparing to deploy its first Starlink V3 satellites on a Starship flight today, marking a major constellation upgrade while Amazon's competing Leo satellite service faces delays and financial setbacks.
content:
SpaceX is gearing up for a monumental flight today that's sure to be closely watched by Amazon. If successful, SpaceX will deploy its first Starlink V3 satellites, which tout meaningful upgrades to the ever-expanding Starlink constellation. The 26 satellites will be riding atop Starship, which SpaceX will also attempt to deploy into Earth orbit for the first time. The mission arrives amid Amazon's ongoing setbacks with launch partners that are keeping its own Leo satellites grounded, and falling further behind its plan to offer a meaningful rival to Elon Musk's space internet service.

Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: SpaceX推进下一代Starlink，亚马逊竞争产品陷入困境
zh.summary: SpaceX准备在今天的Starship飞行中部署其首批Starlink V3卫星，标志着星座的重大升级，而亚马逊竞争的Leo卫星服务面临延迟和财务困难。

title: Microsoft goes quiet after church groups ask for 1% of data center costs
summary: Church groups have requested Microsoft contribute 1% of its data center costs as part of corporate responsibility efforts, but Microsoft has remained silent on the proposal despite claiming commitment to being a good neighbor.
content: “Microsoft claims to want to be a good neighbor, but the jury is still out."

zh.title: 教会团体要求微软贡献数据中心成本的1%后，微软保持沉默
zh.summary: 教会团体已要求微软将其数据中心成本的1%作为企业社会责任的一部分，但尽管微软声称致力于做一个好邻居，但对该提议保持沉默。

title: Honor’s Magic 9 Pro Max has a big camera and a bigger battery
summary: Honor has unveiled its Magic 9 Pro Max flagship smartphone in China, featuring an Arri-inspired camera system with cinematic capabilities and an exceptionally large battery, marking the company's first major flagship since partnering with the camera manufacturer.
content:
This mossy green looks great, but the 9 Pro Max is also launching in black and silver. | Image: Honor	

Honor launches its new Magic 9 flagship phones in China today, and the 9 Pro Max features a design revamp, a capable camera, and a colossal battery.
This is Honor's first flagship launch - Robot Phone aside - since it announced its collaboration with camera company Arri. The initial impact is twofold. The new camera island is Arri-inspired, drawing from the "three-lens turret" design first introduced in 1937's Arriflex 35, complete with a knurled texture around the main lens.
Arri has played a part in the camera itself, contributing the ability to shoot in Arri LogC3, together with 14 preset Arri Look LUTs, access to Arri's wider library o …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 荣耀Magic 9 Pro Max配备大摄像头和更大电池
zh.summary: 荣耀在中国推出了Magic 9 Pro Max旗舰智能手机，搭载受Arri启发的摄像头系统，具有电影级功能和特别大的电池，这是该公司与摄像机制造商合作后的首款重要旗舰产品。

title: Truecaller takes its scam intelligence to the open web as it looks beyond caller ID
summary: Truecaller is expanding beyond its traditional caller ID business by launching its scam detection capabilities on the open web, as the company adapts to declining demand for its core service in India, its largest market.
content: Truecaller finds a new way to reach users as pressure grows on its traditional caller ID business in India, its biggest market.

zh.title: Truecaller将欺诈检测扩展到开放网络，超越来电显示功能
zh.summary: Truecaller通过在开放网络上推出其欺诈检测功能来扩展其传统来电显示业务，因为该公司正适应其最大市场印度对其核心服务需求的下降。
